items.text: Connecticut enacted no-excuse absentee voting, becoming the 29th state to allow it, along with a ballot cure process and other election reforms.
Arizona opened in-person early voting for its July 21 primary on June 24, with Maricopa County adding 17 more early voting sites than in 2022.
Georgia's legislature sent a revised QR code ballot tabulation bill to Gov. Kemp, delaying the ban to 2028 and narrowing mandatory hand recount requirements.
South Carolina's June 24 runoffs determined nominees for governor and other key races following the state's competitive primary season.
Texas faced calls to fix its statewide voter registration system after a civil-rights audit found accuracy and accessibility problems.
